tasks.title: Validate generated Invoice intake and approval
steps: Preserve this responsibility and linked requirements: Composed invoice-workflow deployment unit on Azure Container Apps, owning browser/API, background worker, isolated PDF/OCR parser and operating tasks/monitoring. Internal generated resources include Azure Database for PostgreSQL durable transactional queue/outbox and review state, private versioned Azure Blob Storage originals, staff sign-in, separate workload identities and regional model integration; do not provision duplicate internal services. Scope: staff PDF upload, asynchronous extraction of supplier/invoice date/total/currency with source evidence, correction and review, authorized approval, recovery and approved accounting delivery. Support twenty signed-in staff and three reviewers; ordinary uploaders cannot approve. Enforce live application membership and reviewer authorization server-side; sign-in alone grants no approval permission. Accept PDFs up to 10,000,000 bytes, approximately 500 uploads daily and bursts of twenty; jobs may take several minutes without an invented completion deadline. Return durable job/status references and keep processing independent of browser connections. Persist stable invoice/job identities and exact source versions. Commit workflow state and queued work transactionally in PostgreSQL. Fence worker leases, recover stalled work, use bounded retries with backoff, and persist exhausted jobs in a visible dead-letter/recovery state with failure reasons. Authorized recovery preserves identities and history instead of creating fresh invoices. Incomplete or failed extraction stays visible for correction. Bind approval to the exact result revision and outbound payload; edits invalidate approval. Use a stable outbound operation ID and payload identity. Record delivery intent before calling accounting; uncertain outcomes are fenced for lookup/reconciliation rather than blindly resent. Accounting must independently pass normalized-action-v1, durable idempotency and uncertain-outcome acceptance; this does not prove its native API compatibility. An administrator supplies the external endpoint and credentials through protected destination configuration; keep credentials out of the diagram, browser, model input and logs. Treat originals and extracted fields as Confidential and potentially personal data. Keep documents and extracted data in Australia across processing, model inference, queues, data-bearing logs, backups and recovery copies. Australia East is proposed, not approved: verify Container Apps, PostgreSQL, Blob Storage, regional model support, quotas, private networking and processing geography. Never silently use global or cross-region inference. Retain originals and extraction audit history for 90 days; qualify retention start, scheduled cleanup, object versions, SQL records and backup expiry without promising universal exact erasure. Keep invoice content out of routine operational logs. Parser isolation, model retention/abuse-monitoring policy, restore, alert delivery and operating ownership require qualification. Acceptance must cover denied uploader approval, burst intake, worker interruption, retry exhaustion/recovery, stale approvals, repeated delivery and lost accounting responses. The diagram and local synthetic evidence do not establish destination behavior or deployment..
